claims: Samsung is discontinuing the Samsung Messages app.
Support for the Samsung Messages app ends in July 2026.
Samsung Messages will be officially discontinued in July 2026.
Samsung is transitioning its users to Google Messages as the default platform on Galaxy devices.
Newer Galaxy devices, such as the S25 and Flip/Fold 6, already come pre-installed with Google Messages instead of Samsung Messages.
Users of devices running Android 11 or older are not affected by this change.
Users with older smartwatches (pre-Galaxy Watch 4) running Tizen OS may experience limited message support.
Users will lose custom Samsung themes.
Users will gain AI-powered features powered by Gemini.
